summary: F1 reproduced first: a read-only Script Console computation combined the live jenkins-agent-large template with each of the four files' podYaml output. Under the default Override the result had no node affinity and no toleration; under Merge it had both. MyDownloadsClient, MyDownloadsServer, ScanToPdfClient and HomelabTerraformProvider now declare yamlMergeStrategy merge(); each repo's one commit is amended and the ledger SHAs are updated. All four pass the controller's linter; kc project test --project root is green.
